title: Hadamard Rigidity of Positive Sojourn Time Distributions for Rotation Coins
summary: We study the distribution of the positive sojourn time for a one-dimensional two state quantum walk, conditioned on return to the origin. Konno showed that, for the Hadamard walk, this conditional distribution is exactly uniform at times divisible by $4$. In this paper, we investigate whether this finite time exact uniformity characterizes the Hadamard coin within the family of rotation coins.
